gate_status: Phase 13.2 Audit Corrected — Implementation Not Started

findings.finding: Duplicate Flyway version prefixes (V1__ to V4__) present in local working tree due to 16 untracked Lineage A files.
findings.evidence: Working tree contains 20 files on disk. Exactly 4 files are tracked in Git (V1-V4 Lineage B). 16 files are untracked and hidden by .git/info/exclude.
findings.current_behavior: In local working tree, Docker Compose auth-migrate and local Docker builds crash on Flyway duplicate version 1. On a clean Git clone, only the 4 tracked files exist and no duplicate collision occurs.
findings.risk: Local environment stack startup failure and dirty container image builds.

findings.finding: Git-tracked Alembic merge head 6f0604b23df6 references untracked parent revision 3f3884863f27, breaking clean clones.
findings.evidence: services/ai-service/alembic/versions/6f0604b23df6_merge_schema_heads.py is tracked in Git with down_revision = ('0008', '3f3884863f27'). 3f3884863f27 is untracked in Git and excluded by .git/info/exclude.
findings.current_behavior: Any clean git clone fails immediately on alembic upgrade head with alembic.util.exc.CommandError: Can't locate revision identified by '3f3884863f27'.
findings.risk: CI/CD pipeline failure, broken staging/production rollouts from clean clones, and disaster recovery failure.

findings.finding: Alembic Branch B migrations in local working tree duplicate DDL already executed in revisions 0001-0007.
findings.evidence: Untracked revision 2248598b8f7e creates uq_trials_hospital_title_condition_phase (already created by 0002). Untracked revision 3f3884863f27 creates trial_embeddings table (already created by 0007).
findings.current_behavior: In the local working tree, upgrading a blank database with alembic upgrade head fails on PostgreSQL relation/constraint already exists errors.
findings.risk: Alembic cannot initialize a clean database from scratch in the current working tree.

findings.finding: Migration packaging mechanism inconsistency between Docker Compose dynamic mount and Kubernetes explicit enumeration, risking future staleness.
findings.evidence: kustomization.yaml lines 102-109 explicitly enumerate the 4 tracked Lineage B files into auth-migration-sql ConfigMap, while docker-compose.yml dynamically mounts the migration directory.
findings.current_behavior: Docker Compose mounts the migration directory dynamically, while Kubernetes explicitly enumerates migration files in kustomization.yaml. They currently contain the same tracked four migrations on a clean clone, but the Kubernetes mechanism can become stale if future tracked migrations are added without updating kustomization.yaml.
findings.risk: Future tracked migrations (V5+) will automatically apply in Docker Compose but will be silently omitted from Kubernetes unless kustomization.yaml is manually updated.

findings.finding: Unsynchronized concurrent Job and Deployment rollout in Kubernetes.
findings.evidence: kustomization.yaml defines flat resource list. Running kubectl apply -k . starts auth-migrate, ai-migrate, auth-service, ai-service, and worker in parallel.
findings.current_behavior: ai-migrate races auth-migrate, failing on foreign key to hospitals table if auth-migrate has not finished creating it.
findings.risk: Cluster rollout failure when manifests are applied directly without deploy.sh procedural wait loops.

findings.finding: Multiple concurrent Flyway migration executions during Kubernetes rollout.
findings.evidence: auth-service/deployment.yaml specifies replicas: 2. application-production.yml sets spring.flyway.enabled: true. auth-migrate Job also runs Flyway.
findings.current_behavior: Three concurrent processes run Flyway migrate against the database on deployment.
findings.risk: Database lock contention and CrashLoopBackOff of application pods.

findings.finding: Untracked Alembic revision 01efd2b23442 executes DDL against auth-service tables (audit_logs, hospitals).
findings.evidence: services/ai-service/alembic/versions/01efd2b23442_schema_validation.py lines 24-34 add columns to audit_logs and index to hospitals.
findings.current_behavior: Alembic alters tables owned by another service in the local working tree graph.
findings.risk: Microservice encapsulation violation and schema drift.

findings.finding: Shared public schema and cross-service physical foreign key dependencies without schema partitioning.
findings.evidence: Both services connect to postgresql://.../medmatch public schema. patients, trials, and matches have FK to hospitals.id.
findings.current_behavior: Services share the same table namespace, preventing independent schema lifecycles.
findings.risk: Tight coupling, blast-radius expansion, and blocked horizontal scaling.

findings.finding: Unconditional table wipe (DELETE FROM roles;) in untracked local migration V10.
findings.evidence: V10__fix_role_seed_data.sql line 1 contains DELETE FROM roles;. File is untracked and absent from Git.
findings.current_behavior: Deletes all role rows if executed locally, aborting with foreign key violation if users exist.
findings.risk: Local migration failure and loss of critical role reference data.

findings.current_behavior: Drops columns and historical audit data if executed locally.
findings.risk: Data loss if untracked files are accidentally executed.

findings.finding: Zero integration test coverage for database migrations and clean-schema upgrades.

findings.risk: Broken migrations and syntax errors escape to staging and production.
